tool_args.rationale: The five initial rows are short-horizon observations and leave the dual-horizon adaptation parameters ambiguous. Since the forecast horizon is 20, acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The parameters are not identifiable well enough from short horizons, and the target forecast horizon is 20.
It does not directly resolve the long-horizon reversal ambiguity as efficiently as the discriminating probe.
It is irrelevant to the identified mechanism and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
The recalled mechanism and pilot signatures instead point to sink-coupled adaptation; no oscillatory evidence supports this alternative.
